correctness.rationale: The all-strict image-rank drop criterion is necessary and sufficient; it produces a one-to-one correspondence of geodesic words and removal-ordered rooted forests. Path component extensions are two-chain shuffles, counted as 2^(ell-1) across roots. Summing interleavings via multinomial theorem gives 2^m k^m on paths; marking a missing cut edge and dividing by k gives the factor n/k on cycles. Empty word, n=1 path, k=1 reset, and C3 boundaries are explicit. Direct function enumeration for 10 sizes and independent image-subset DP for 22 sizes confirm formulas; 65 exact ratio tests passed. No experiment is used as a proof for all sizes.

value.rationale: This is a natural family-wide exact word-growth invariant of the edge-generated transformation monoid, solving every target rank for paths and cycles. The ratio n/(n-m) and explicit reset-root multiplicities quantify precisely how adding one closing edge changes the geodesic language; it is substantially more than the familiar rank lower bound or one reset-word construction. Distinguishing words from elements is scientifically essential.
